Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, write KVL for the series loop: Vs = iR + vC. Because Vs is a constant, differentiating with respect to time gives 0 = R(di/dt) + i(dR/dt) + dvC/dt. The capacitor current relation is i = C(dvC/dt), so dvC/dt = i/C, therefore 0 = R(di/dt) + i(dR/dt) + i/C. It is known that R(t)=R0(1-t/T), so dR/dt = -R0/T. Also T=3R0C, therefore R0/T = 1/(3C). Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 0.25.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a source-switch-resistor-capacitor series loop with current I(t) through R(t). From the text take R(t)=R_0(1-t/T), R_0=1 ohm, C=1 F, T=3R_0C, and I(0)=1 A. Apply KVL in the series loop, V_s=iR+v_C, then differentiate because V_s is constant and R is time-dependent: 0=R di/dt+i dR/dt+i/C. Rearrange to an integrable ODE for i(t), substitute dR/dt=-R_0/T and T=3R_0C, integrate from 0 to T/2, then round the resulting current.

图像描述：附图显示一个单回路串联 RC 充电电路。左侧是电压源 Vs，顶部串联有可变电阻 R(t)，右侧是电容 C，回路中标出了电流 I(t) 的方向，并有一个在 t=0 动作的开关。因此该电路满足源电压等于电阻压降加电容电压。

推理计算：由题给 R0=1 Ω，C=1 F，T=3R0C=3 s，Vs=1 V，I(0)=1 A。令 x(t)=Vs-vC(t)，即电阻两端电压。因为 I(t)=x(t)/R(t)，且电容电流满足 C dvC/dt=I=x(t)/R(t)，所以 dx/dt=-dvC/dt=-x(t)/(R(t)C)。初值为 x(0)=I(0)R(0)=1×1=1 V。代入 R(t)=R0(1-t/T)，C=1：dx/x=-dt/[R0C(1-t/T)]。从 0 积分到 T/2：ln[x(T/2)/x(0)]=-∫0^(T/2) dt/[R0C(1-t/T)]。由于 T=3R0C，该积分为 3 ln 2，所以 x(T/2)=1×e^(-3 ln 2)=1/8=0.125 V。此时 R(T/2)=R0(1-1/2)=0.5 Ω。因此 I(T/2)=x(T/2)/R(T/2)=0.125/0.5=0.25 A。

The RC circuit shown below has a variable resistance \( R(t) \) given by the following expression:
\[
R(t) = R_0 \left(1 - \frac{t}{T} \right) \text{ for } 0 \leq t < T
\]
where \( R_0 = 1 \,\Omega \) and \( C = 1 \,F \). We are also given that \( T = 3R_0C \) and the source voltage is \( V_s = 1 \,V \). If the current at time \( t = 0 \) is 1 A, then the current \( I(t) \), in amperes, at time \( t = T/2 \) is ________ (rounded to 2 decimal places).

We are also given that \( T = 3R_0C \) and the source voltage is \( V_s = 1 \,V \). ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a single-loop series RC circuit, with a DC voltage source Vs on the left, a current arrow I(t) above pointing to the right and flowing through the variable resistor R(t), a capacitor C on the right, and a switch operated at t=0 below, the whole forming a source-switch-resistor-capacitor series loop. Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, write KVL for the series loop: Vs = iR + vC. Because Vs is a constant, differentiating with respect to time gives 0 = R(di/dt) + i(dR/dt) + dvC/dt. The capacitor current relation is i = C(dvC/dt), so dvC/dt = i/C, therefore 0 = R(di/dt) + i(dR/dt) + i/C. It is known that R(t)=R0(1-t/T), so dR/dt = -R0/T. Also T=3R0C, therefore R0/T = 1/(3C). Substituting gives R(di/dt) + i(1/C - R0/T)=0, namely R(di/dt) + i(2/(3C))=0. Since R=R0(1-t/T), and T=3R0C, di/i = -[2/T]/(1-t/T) dt. Integrating from t=0 to t=T/2: ln(i(T/2)/i(0)) = ∫0 to T/2 -[2/T]/(1-t/T) dt = 2 ln(1-t/T)|0 to T/2 = 2 ln(1/2) = ln(1/4). The initial current i(0)=1 A, therefore i(T/2)=1×1/4=0.25 A. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 0.25.
